S.label: System
S.desc: Keys, status enums, timestamps. Follows the table-level grant.

C0.label: Business
C0.desc: Non-personal company data: plan names, rates, legal entity names.

C1.label: Personal
C1.desc: Identifies a person in a work context: name, work email, dates, title.

C3.label: Restricted PII
C3.desc: Aadhaar, PAN, SSN, bank, DOB, addresses, contacts, visa. Encrypted or masked; decrypt per purpose.

C4.label: Special category
C4.desc: Race, disability, veteran, medical reason, ER findings, background findings, garnishments.

roles.name: Daydor admin
roles.desc: Runs the platform: schema, migrations, tenant provisioning. Sees platform metadata and counts, never tenant people data. Break-glass needs two approvers and is fully audited.

roles.name: Daydor ops
roles.desc: Operates payroll and compliance on the client’s behalf (the managed-service model). Full working access inside assigned tenants only; restricted PII stays masked on screen because agents decrypt it at the moment of use.

roles.name: Founder / owner
roles.desc: The client company’s approver of record. Sees the whole company and approves money-moving and threshold gates. Restricted PII is masked; special-category data appears only as aggregates.

roles.name: HR admin
roles.desc: Client-side people lead. Full Core HR including restricted PII, decrypted per purpose and logged. Special-category data only by designation (EEO officer, ER investigator).

roles.name: Payroll & finance
roles.desc: Runs pay, filings and spend. Sees compensation in full; bank and PAN stay masked because disbursal decrypts inside the worker, not on screen.

roles.name: IT admin
roles.desc: Identity, app access and devices. Sees who works here and when they start or leave. No pay, no performance, no PII.

roles.name: People manager
roles.desc: Sees their reporting subtree (direct and indirect) through reporting_closure. Reviews, time, leave and team expenses. Leave reasons and PII hidden; team pay visible only if the tenant enables it.

roles.name: Employee
roles.desc: Self-service on their own record. The only role that can grant or withdraw DPDP consent and submit self-identification. Colleagues’ directory fields come through a separate employee_directory view.

roles.name: External auditor
roles.desc: Time-boxed, read-only access for a statutory inspection or SOC 2. Restricted PII masked, special-category excluded, every query logged.

roles.name: Domain agents
roles.desc: Service principals, one database role per domain orchestrator. Rights follow the worker map from the agent graph; RLS still applies; C3 decrypts only through app.decrypt_pii(column, purpose).

tables.description: One row per client company and the root of isolation: every tenant-scoped row’s tenant_id references it.

A registered employer under the tenant, such as an Indian Pvt Ltd, a US Inc, or an EOR partner. Payroll, filings, benefits and thresholds hang off the entity because statutory registrations are per entity.
Org units as a tree. Carries the cost centre that GL postings roll up to.
Work locations. state_code drives PT slabs in India and state tax nexus in the US.
Who can log in, distinct from employee (a record about a person). tenant_id is nullable only for Daydor staff, the one deliberate exception to tenant scoping.
Grants a role at a scope (tenant, department, team, self). This makes access hierarchical: one person can be an employee everywhere, a manager over a subtree, and the EEO officer by designation.
Soft per-tenant preferences as data, never schema. Holds the switch for whether managers see team pay.
One polymorphic row per gate instance, pointing at whatever it guards. deadline_at closes Gap 2 (registration_deadline_scheduler) from the design doc.
One row per agent worker execution. Gives gated-irreversible workers a durable idempotency record and lets ops see what agents did without reading Temporal history.
The vault (document_vault in the 32-table ERD). document_class picks the retention rule; blobs live in India-resident object storage behind signed URLs.
Purpose- and field-scoped DPDP consent, one row per (employee, data_category, purpose). Only the data principal writes it; PAN, bank and Aadhaar columns cannot be populated without a granted row.
DPDP access, correction and erasure requests with the 90-day clock. partially_fulfilled_retention_held is the honest outcome when a statutory floor wins.
Append-only business-event log written in the same transaction as the mutation. Indexed by (tenant_id, subject_id, occurred_at) for the 72-hour breach report.
Backs the root orchestrator’s legal-hold gate. Every irreversible worker checks for an active hold on its subject before acting.
Shared reference: duration plus the anchor field the clock starts from (filed_on, last_entry_date, employee.date_of_exit, created_at). Four statutes, four anchors.
Professional-tax slabs per state, effective-dated so a past period always recomputes against the slab in force then.
Generalises the doc’s epf_rate_rule and esi_rate_rule into one effective-dated table keyed by scheme, so US FICA, FUTA and SUI rates fit the same shape.
One person in one tenant (employee_core in the 32-table ERD). hire_event_id is the creation idempotency key. Raw Aadhaar is never stored: masked last-4 plus an offline e-KYC reference.
Effective-dated job and pay structure. Immutable once a payroll run has used it; a raise is a new version. wage_floor_compliant enforces the Labour Codes 50% Basic+DA floor.
A budgeted seat, distinct from the person in it, so backfills and reorgs keep headcount-plan history. headcount-planner already assumes this exists.
Company-level reference data the gap analysis flagged as load-bearing: replaces free-text job_title and gives comp-band-validator something to validate against.
Pay range per job profile and geo, effective-dated. The other half of the job_profile / comp_band follow-up blocking comp-band-validator.
Effective-dated reporting edges. A materialised closure built from this table is what the manager RLS policy checks: is this row’s employee anywhere under me?
A flat miss in the 32-table list. Needed from day one at any company size.
Case-status tracking for I-9, E-Verify, H-1B, OPT and TN with expiry and next action, instead of a static document in the vault.
Voluntary EEO self-ID kept apart from decision records in a restricted schema. Hiring managers never see it; reporting reads an aggregate view only.
Per-scheme applicability (ESI, EPF, Gratuity, POSH, ACA ALE, EEO-1, WARN) per legal entity, with the founder confirmation gate and a registration deadline.
One skill catalogue shared by recruiting, performance, learning and succession.
Proficiency per person per skill with its source, so training and succession have something to reason from.
Request to fill a position, routed for budget sign-off.
A published req. pay_transparency_checked closes the review flag: no posting goes live without a salary-range check.
A person before hire. Kept separate from employee per TA’s own boundary: candidate is not employee until hire is confirmed.
Candidate applied to a requisition, with stage history.
Automated screening output, the highest-exposure decision in TA. Records tool version, audit in force, candidate notice and human review so LL144, IL HB3773 and CO SB24-205 are provable.
Bias-audit currency for each screening tool. aedt-audit-monitor blocks the screener when expires_on has passed.
Scheduled interviews and scorecards.
Vendor check plus the FCRA adverse-action stages. Findings are special category: HR only.
Offer drafted from the approved band. within_band false routes to the founder.
One checklist per lifecycle event. kind is onboarding or offboarding, so ER reuses the same shape.
Tasks owned by different domains (IT, payroll, the manager, the new hire). blocking tasks hold the next stage.
Default app bundle per job profile and department. Anything outside it is an exception gate.
Directory identity (Google, Okta, Entra). Deprovisioning always passes through a gate.
Per-app access with its source (template or exception). The input to access-compliance-auditor’s drift check.
Hardware inventory.
Who holds which device, including the shipping address (restricted).
Per-employee pay setup. Carries the tax-residency fields from the gap analysis (work_state vs tax_state, reciprocity) plus India UAN and ESIC numbers.
One cycle for one legal entity. Maker-checker: payroll builds it, the founder releases it.
Derived per employee per run, and pinned to the employment_record version it used so it stays an honest record after later changes.
Earnings and deduction components, each pointing at the rule row that produced it, so a recompute is explainable line by line.
Court-ordered deductions. Special category: the issuing authority and order reveal legal circumstances.
One statutory submission (ECR, ESI, 24Q, 941, W-2, state UI) with its acknowledgement.
Running per-employee gratuity liability, read (not recomputed) by final settlement at exit.
Global and contractor invoices routed through local payment rails.
Plans offered per entity and plan year (group health in India, medical and 401k in the US).
What the employee chose, effective-dated, and when it reached the carrier.
Covered family members. Restricted PII about people who are not employees.
Qualifying life events. The event type itself (divorce, birth) is special category.
COBRA qualifying events and the statutory notice timeline.
Raw punches. Geo is restricted and optional.
Approved hours per period, the hand-off from time to payroll.
Leave types and accrual rules per entity.
Accrued balance per policy, also read by final settlement for encashment.
Dates are visible to managers; the medical or family reason is special category and hidden from them.
A proposed pay change (merit, promotion, adjustment, bonus). Approval writes a new employment_record version rather than editing the old one.
Options, RSUs and Indian ESOPs, priced against the valuation in force on the grant date.
Scheduled and realised vesting tranches.
Exercises with FMV and withholding, an irreversible worker.
US 409A, or the India Rule 11UA FMV report used for ESOP perquisite tax. Stale valuations trip the 409A gate.
A review period and its calibration status.
Self assessment, manager rating, and the calibrated rating that feeds merit.
Performance plans are tracked by an agent, never initiated by one.
Course catalogue with jurisdiction rules (POSH in India, state harassment training in the US).
training_record in the 32-table ERD: assigned courses, deadlines and completion.
Licences and certifications with expiry; role-critical ones hard-stop.
Employee expenses checked against policy and routed by amount.
Card limits set per role.
Three-way match on vendor bills, gated above materiality.
Ledger postings. Payroll posts at cost-centre grain, never per employee, so finance staff never infer an individual’s pay from the GL.
Complaints logged and routed by agents, never adjudicated by them. Founder sees that a case exists but not its content, since in a small company the founder may be the subject.
Investigation notes, encrypted and append-only. Readable only by the assigned investigator role.
The exit event every downstream domain reacts to (IT deprovisioning, final pay, COBRA, equity).
Full and final: pending wages, gratuity from the running balance, encashment and recoveries, released through the same disbursal worker as payroll.

gates.label: Offer or comp change outside band
Action during legal hold or audit

flows.name: Requisition to first payslip
flows.sum: Seat, req, screening, offer, record, consent, access, pay.
steps: Confirms a budgeted vacant seat exists before a req can open.
Drafted from the hiring manager’s input.
Pay-range check must pass before it goes live.
Tool version, audit in force, notice sent, human review recorded.
Out of band routes to the founder.
hire_event_id is the idempotency key, not the name.
Only the employee can grant. Blocks PAN, bank and Aadhaar collection.
US only. The 3-business-day clock runs from the first day worked.
Anything off the role template is gated.

flows.name: Monthly payroll cycle
flows.sum: Hours and rules in, gated disbursal out, filings and GL after.
steps: The version effective in the period, not today’s.
EPF, ESI, FICA, SUI rows effective in the period.
Deviation from history holds the run.
The party that computed pay cannot release it.
Decrypts bank details via decrypt_pii(…, salary_disbursement) after checking consent_record.
Each line points at the rule row that produced it.
India only. Running balance, updated every period.

flows.name: Termination to full and final
flows.sum: Holds checked, access cut, settlement gated, retention clocks start.
steps: The event every domain reacts to.
An active hold freezes irreversible steps.
Reads the running balance; never recomputes at exit.
Same gated worker as routine payroll.
date_of_exit set. This is the Gratuity Act retention anchor.

flows.name: DPDP erasure request
flows.sum: Anonymise what you can, hold what statute requires, prove it.
steps: Withdrawn as a new event, not an edit.
Name, Aadhaar, PAN and bank references anonymised.
id_proof class deleted; statutory_filing class held.
The anchor field decides what is still inside its floor.
Held inside the TDS and PF floor, now under an unlinkable id.
Append-only record of what was anonymised and what was held.

flows.name: Merit cycle to new pay
flows.sum: Ratings to proposals to bands to a new effective-dated record.
steps: A new version; the wage-floor check reruns in India.
Refresh grants, priced against the current valuation.

flows.name: Headcount crosses a statutory threshold
flows.sum: Count per scheme, confirm, register before the deadline.
steps: Counts per scheme using employment_type, not raw rows.
US EEO-1 at 100 employees. Aggregate view only.
